status: one-seed Z-only convergence and causal-gate diagnostic; not a headline result

gate_audit.gate_1_goal_decodability: fail: held-out facet accuracy .661 is below the approximate .90 target
gate_audit.gate_2_causal_identity: improved but not passed: the one-seed correct-minus-shuffled effect is .102 and requires stronger representation plus replication
gate_audit.gate_3_counterfactual_control: fail: target-facet change is .936 but isolated/full counterfactual success is only .285
gate_audit.decision: do not restore direct goal access or run depth/time grids; repair the Z representation on a simpler canonical goal channel first

interpretation: Longer joint training strengthens task performance and more than doubles the correct-versus-shuffled effect relative to the short late-layer pilot.
The train-to-test probe gap remains large, indicating that the encoder does not generalize goal extraction across held-out prompt topology.
A high target-facet substitution rate alone overstates causal control because most substituted generations fail to preserve all untouched facets.
The next experiment should isolate latent channel capacity and conditioning use with a canonical authoritative goal prompt before reintroducing distractors and topology shifts.
